forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.submittedBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset the password. The link expires in 60 minutes and can only be used once.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been updated, and you've been signed out on every device. Log in with your new password to continue.
resetPassword.missingTokenBody: This password reset link is missing its token. It may have been truncated by your email client. Request a new link to try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Start managing feedback across your branches.
